description: R-SQL-1/R-SQL-3 fixture r-sql-13b-main: tables JA, JB, JC, JD (Long keys with Null rows), CX, CY, CZ (empty), ONE (one row), GA (groups with Nulls), SI (typed boundary values in four groups), TB (Yes/No, Memo, Text), TG (GUID), MMP (Memo values that differ at chosen positions), PV (crosstab source), BT (BETWEEN and LIKE operand types) and LK (LIKE text rows). Created in ACCDB by DBEngine.CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, 128); DDL and literal rows go through Database.Execute with dbFailOnError, exact typed values (Single, Currency, Date, long Memo, GUID) through table-type AddNew/Value/Update. Every call's outcome is captured and the closed file is kept.
